designs.title: Record a debt: paid options (r1), working
designs.what: The real Record a debt screen built from the app's own code. Changed only on Repeats and Installments: nothing runs off the side, the 'Replaces the due date' note is gone (your due date is still kept), and on a plan without the option the panel is much dimmer while the badge pulses bright. ··· → Free / Starter / Pro, and 'As built today' to compare.

designs.title: Shop QR camera test (A / B / C)
designs.what: Open on the Android. Point the iPhone's ordinary Camera at A, then B, then C. A banner appearing means it reads; tap it to see which one it read.

designs.title: Your Pulo code (r3), working
designs.what: No white plate: the code sits on the page, black in light, white in dark. Test it: scan this page's code with Pulo Dev's Scan on an iPhone and on an Android, in both themes. ··· → Dark: old white plate, to compare.

designs.title: Your Pulo code (r2), working
designs.what: Your second marks: the page name at the app's page-name size, everything a little lower, "Show this at the counter." only, "Scan the shop's QR", Replace asks in two short lines, and after a replace "This is your new code" in bold. The scan uses Telegram's real camera. ··· lists the changes and lets you try a slow or failed connection, a failed replace and a shop scanning you.

designs.title: Your Pulo code (r1), working
designs.what: The page as built, with only your marks changed: bigger line under the title, one short line instead of two paragraphs, Scan the shop's code first and filled, Replace under it, both in the bottom bar. Scan uses Telegram's real camera: a Pulo shop code opens the shop, any other code says so at once. ··· lists what changed and lets you try a slow or failed connection, a failed replace, and a shop scanning you.

designs.title: Your review of 18 Nov: every mark fixed (r1)
designs.what: Your code, Record a debt (blinking 0, Installments), Send the invite, I owe (both tabs, both empty states), one shop, Pay as a half sheet on the keyboard, paying one debt, the owner's Record payment sheet, Updates. Tap ··· to switch screens; it also says what changed on each. Try Theme.

designs.title: Paying one debt: the owner's screens (r1)
designs.what: Record payment from a debt names that debt, with "Everything, oldest first" one tap away; the debt lists the payments that went to it; Approvals says what a payment is for; the same for a supplier's bill. Dashed outlines mark what is new (Marks hides them). Tap ··· to switch screens.

designs.title: Home with nothing recorded (r1)
designs.what: Only the icon and "Nothing recorded yet", centred on the screen; a pointer floats gently above Record. ··· switches between an arrow (A) and three chevrons (B), and the theme.

designs.title: The customer's first minutes (r6)
designs.what: r5 marks: the running total in a grey plate, the selected tab filled, no lines anywhere, Pay and Call built exactly like the approved debt page's button. Tap ··· to switch screens; try Theme.

designs.title: Home: I owe is yours, suppliers get a row (r3)
designs.what: The I owe tile shows what you personally owe (0 when nothing) and opens your list; suppliers move to a thin row. Chips: owes nobody, personal debt, personal + suppliers, assistant view, offline.

designs.title: Onboarding: the owl, clean lines (r10)
designs.what: Your owl redrawn line by line: every line one even thin stroke, clean joins, a clean perch, blinking every 3 seconds. "Show today's" switches to what is built now.

designs.title: Is this you? shorter words (MICRO-14)
designs.what: The four screens a link can show, with the proposed shorter words. Tap the chips to switch; "Show old words" compares with what is built today.

designs.title: Send the invite: the page inside Pulo (r4)
designs.what: No outline: a soft filled bubble, dots pulsing, gently floating.

designs.title: Send the invite: the browser page (r3)
designs.what: Smaller wordmark close to the card, no shop line, the amount fits any size (··· top-left: try 2 500 000 000), 'one hour' above the button.

designs.title: Add note check: note at the top (D)
designs.what: Opens on D: Add note puts the box at the top, keyboard below. The grey pill switches D, A, B, C.

designs.title: Next button on Android: above the keyboard (estimated)
designs.what: Keyboard estimated at 38.5% of the screen: on the Lenovo, Next sits just above the keyboard with the same small gap as the iPhone.

designs.title: Next button: THE FIX (red box starts with FIX PAGE)
designs.what: The fix. The red box now sits at the top so you can see Next. On the Lenovo, Next appears right under the field you type in.

designs.title: Next button: old code as shipped (fails on purpose)
designs.what: Pulo's real Record a debt layout code. Tap a field: the red box says whether Next is VISIBLE or HIDDEN.

designs.title: Record a debt r9 in one font (Pulo Round)
designs.what: Your approved r9, same behaviour, with Comfortaa everywhere (including buttons and Ҳ) and the new size code. Compare it with r9.

designs.title: Type: one font, one size code (r2)
designs.what: The nine sizes for the whole app, in all four alphabets, with the new Ҳ ҳ. The bottom button opens Record a debt in it.

designs.title: Record a debt r9: all fixes, to approve
designs.what: Full screen always. Pulo’s own bottom button sits on the keyboard (iOS and Android). Next guides you; tap any field to fill by hand. Options: ⋯ → Settings.

designs.title: Record a debt (approved r8, live)
designs.what: Your approved design with the real keyboard and Telegram’s real bottom button. Opens full screen like the real app. Options (plan, From a person, theme): ⋯ → Settings.

designs.title: Telegram check (for the Lenovo)
designs.what: Shows what this phone's Telegram can do, with the app's own test. Screenshot it on both phones; try the grey button with the keyboard open.

designs.title: Fonts: eight that cover all four languages
designs.what: Tap a font at the top or the bottom button to switch. Type in the box to try the keyboard.
